about: Prose input + choice questions (designed in the playground; wording verbatim). One /v1/systemone call per decision with all questions; state = perception prose (pad sentence + altitude/descent sentence).

flight_direction.instructions: Determine whether to fly to the right or to the left

criteria.none: no need to fly left or right

flight_velocity.instructions: Determine how fast to fly based on how far the pad is

criteria.fast: fly fast if the pad is far
criteria.slow: fly slowly if the pad is near
criteria.very_slow: fly very slowly if the pad is very near
criteria.none: no velocity needed if the pad is directly below

downward_thrust_magnitude.instructions: You are piloting a lunar lander. Determine the magnitude of the thrust needed to slow the descent of the lander based on its altitude.

criteria.large: a lot of thrust is needed because the lander has low altitude and is descending very fast
criteria.medium: some thrust is needed but the lander has low altitude and is descending slowly
criteria.small: very little thrust is needed because the lander is descending slowly or has high altitude
criteria.none: no thrust is needed because the lander is not descending
